name: Enhanced Audio
author: Moritz Wallinger
description: Combat and health audio cues with an optional Enhanced RAC Style status panel.

settings.name: Hit confirmation
settings.description: Play a short cue when your attack hits a moby.

settings.name: Damage cue
settings.description: Play a low thump when Ratchet actually loses health.

settings.name: Empty-ammo cue
settings.description: Play a click when a weapon cannot spend the ammo required for a shot.

settings.name: Low-health heartbeat
settings.description: Loop a quiet heartbeat while health is at or below the threshold.

settings.name: Low-health threshold
settings.description: Health at which the heartbeat starts.

settings.name: Enhanced RAC status panel
settings.description: Show a small Ratchet & Clank-inspired panel with the active audio cue groups.
